key_moments: 29' Kaishu Sano scores for Japan after a solo run, giving them a 1-0 lead.
56' Casemiro equalizes for Brazil with a header from a Gabriel Magalhães assist.
90'+6 Gabriel Martinelli scores the dramatic winning goal for Brazil in stoppage time, assisted by Bruno Guimarães.
12' Kaishu Sano (Japan) receives a yellow card.
52' Japan's goalkeeper Zion Suzuki makes a crucial save on a Brazil header.

standout_performers.reason: Scored the equalizer and controlled midfield.
Made several key saves to keep Japan in the game.
Scored Japan's opening goal with an impressive individual effort.

matches.tactical_summary: Japan executed a disciplined defensive strategy after taking an early lead through a counter-attack, aiming to frustrate Brazil. Brazil dominated possession and relentlessly attacked, eventually breaking down Japan's resistance with two second-half goals to secure the comeback victory.

narrative: Brazil mounted a dramatic comeback in the Round of 32, scoring a late winner to overcome a resilient Japan side that had taken an early lead. This hard-fought victory sends the five-time champions into the Round of 16, while Japan's impressive tournament run comes to a heartbreaking end.
next_round_notes: Brazil's Lucas Paqueta was substituted at halftime due to an injury, which will require further assessment. Casemiro also received a yellow card during the match.
